title: Resistance bounds for finite vertex-transitive graphs
exact_target: Bound all pairwise resistances in finite transitive graphs by degree and diameter, and show resistance is negligible relative to sublinear diameter.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000059 (AMR-099-0059). CC BY 4.0.
